dmp.title: DMP for recovery after knee replacement
dmp.description: How long patients take to walk, climb stairs and return to work after a knee replacement, from the follow-up visits of a partner clinic.
dmp.ethical_issues_description: Approved by the clinic's ethics committee (EK 1187/2025). The clinic anonymises every record before it reaches the project, so the project never holds names, birth dates or other identifying data.

dataset.title: Anonymised recovery measurements
dataset.description: One row per follow-up visit: a random study id, the operated knee, and the days until the patient walked without help, climbed stairs and returned to work.

security_and_privacy.title: Anonymisation
security_and_privacy.description: The clinic replaces names and birth dates with a random study id before export. The key stays at the clinic.
